note_en: C. ferus is the wild Bactrian camel (critically endangered); the domestic Bactrian camel is C. bactrianus. Check which one the video shows.

note_en: Goatfishes left Perciformes after Betancur-R et al. 2014; Catalogue of Life gives Mulliformes. The list already uses post-2014 orders elsewhere (Spariformes, Moroniformes, Carangiformes, Blenniiformes), so this one stands out.
